title: Conservation laws for circuits
concepts_taught: Connect the junction rule to conservation of charge.
Assign current directions consistently and solve junction-current relations.
Connect the loop rule to conservation of energy.
Choose a loop direction and apply consistent signs to e.m.f.s and potential drops.
skills_students_can_now_use: Apply conservation of charge to currents at a junction.
Apply conservation of energy to potential changes around a closed loop.
